reading.body:
WinEuropa is tagged as a data center in OpenStreetMap but its name and location suggest it is likely an IT reseller or support business rather than a commercial facility serving external customers.

The name combines "Win," evocative of Microsoft Windows or PC computing, with "Europa," a pattern typical of regional IT sales and support companies. Businesses of this kind maintain modest office IT infrastructure to run sales, support, and logistics operations. This differs fundamentally from a colocation or cloud data center that operates facilities for outside customers and consumes power at scale.

Verification of WinEuropa's exact business line could not be completed, so this entry remains a probable mistag based on naming convention alone. The distinction matters because OpenStreetMap's telecom=data_center tag conflates corporate IT offices with power-intensive compute infrastructure. For tracking AI's binding constraint on the grid, misclassification of small office facilities as data centers introduces noise into regional power demand estimates.
